<thought>All measured resistances satisfy R(A,X)+R(X,B)=R(A,B), and the resistance between any two nodes equals the absolute difference of their distances from A. This indicates the circuit is a simple series chain of resistors with nodes ordered by increasing distance from A:
A – X1 – N_b1 – N_b2 – N_b3 – X2 – N_c1 – N_c2 – N_c3 – X3 – N_d1 – N_d2 – B.
The resistor values are the differences between consecutive node distances. This yields 12 resistors.</thought>
